note: The most rows one batch of the accountant's valuations may carry, one row per asset. A larger file is split by the person who imports it; the file is refused as a whole, never cut.
The most figures one report page may ask for in a single read. A page that needs more is split into several reads; the batch is refused whole, never cut.
Guardrail: the longest lead, in days, of a subscription invoice before the month starts. The server clamps to the same value.
How many minutes before its start a booking can be checked in. A minute grid wider than this widens it to one grid step.
Minutes before a booking starts at which the check-in reminder is shown.
Guardrail: how many days ahead a device schedules check-in reminders. A device scheduling horizon, not a booking rule.
Guardrail: how many unanswered booking questions one device keeps. A local recovery list, not an owner choice.
Shortest stay booked on the spot, used when the usual window would cross the end of the day.
Length of the stay booked on the spot (badge or space code) when the workspace books by the minute.
Guardrail: the longest range one calendar request may ask for. A platform-owned bound on the query.
How many days ahead the member directory shows the next booking of a member.
Days after issue before a first reminder is suggested and before an invoice falls due when the workspace stated no payment term.
Guardrail: the longest period one capacity figure may cover. A platform-owned bound on the query.
Guardrail: months beyond the first that one finance figure may span (23 means 24 months in all). A platform-owned bound on the query.
Minutes an assistant-requested action waits for the person to confirm it. A confirmation keeps the expiry it was created with. May be shortened, never lengthened.
Days an operator notice that has been read is kept before it is purged. Only read notices are purged: an unread notice, a grant, a consent and the audit trail are never touched by this value.
Minutes a successful check of the MCP endpoint stays fresh enough to turn the interface on. May be shortened, never lengthened.
Guardrail: the longest window one assistant read may ask for. A platform-owned bound on the query, not a permission to scan more.
Minutes after sending in which the author may still correct a message. A workspace message reads its own workspace, a personal or group message the platform value.
Groups one person may create per hour. May be lowered, never raised.
Seconds between two refreshes of the inbox and its unread badge. Lower values load the server more.
Message requests one person may send per day to people who did not allow them. May be lowered, never raised.
Seconds between two refreshes of an open conversation. Lower values load the server more.
How many servers the personal space asks at once when it gathers a person's own records. A bound on the device's parallel reads, not on any server.
Seconds the personal space waits for one server's answer before it shows that server as unavailable and goes on with the others.
Guardrail: the longest period one read of a person's reservations may ask for. A platform-owned bound on the query, resolved by the server that answers.
How many of a person's reservations one server returns per page. The server that answers resolves it once per read, whatever workspaces the page spans.
Days the personal space shows by default when it lists a person's reservations, and the window a read without an end date covers. A query default, not a booking rule.
Minutes after its last heartbeat a person still counts as online. Keep it above the 2-minute heartbeat.

A payable of at least this amount, in whole currency units, is paid by someone other than the person who approved its bill; splitting it into small payments does not get round the limit. 0 switches the rule off.

A supplier bill below this amount, in whole currency units, may be approved by the person who drafted or sent it, if that person may approve expenses. 0 keeps the rule that another person approves every bill. Rejecting always takes another person.
Days an export the app recorded still counts as recent evidence that recovery works. Older than this, recovery reads as unverified.
Years a US space keeps its records when its state asks for more or less than the federal default of the retention rule. 0 means the rule applies. Never legal advice: confirm the period of your state.
Failed badge PIN attempts within the lockout window before a badge is locked. May be tightened (fewer attempts), never loosened.
Minutes over which failed badge PIN attempts are counted, and for which a locked badge stays locked. May be lengthened, never shortened.
Days a personal invitation stays redeemable. An invitation keeps the expiry it was created with. May be shortened, never lengthened.
Days a valid VAT-number check stays recent enough to stand as evidence on a new invoice. A shorter value asks for a fresh check sooner; it is not proof that a transaction is valid.
